title: NIMIS: A Structure-Agnostic, Chemically Informed Slot-Attention Framework for Demixing 1D $^1$H-NMR Mixture Spectra
abstract: arXiv:2611.25629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The products of chemical reactions are usually complex mixtures that must be separated into their components before interpretable $^1$H-NMR spectra can be obtained. Direct analysis of the spectra of crude mixtures would accelerate reaction analysis and facilitate the exploration of new chemical space. We present NIMIS, a structure-agnostic, attention-based deep learning framework that groups the peaks of a 1D $^1$H-NMR mixture spectrum according to the component from which they originate. J-coupling information is introduced directly into the attention mechanism of a multi-head Transformer encoder, and the resulting contextualised peak embeddings are separated into components by slot attention. NIMIS was trained on 158,005 synthetic mixtures constructed from experimental spectra in the NMRexp database, covering molecules of up to 20 heavy atoms composed of C, H, N, O, S, F, Cl, Br and I. On held-out molecules it reaches a peak-to-compone

translated_title: NIMIS：一种结构无关、化学信息驱动的槽注意力框架，用于分离一维 ¹H-NMR 混合物光谱
translated_abstract: 化学反应的产物通常是复杂的混合物，必须先将其分离为各个组分，才能获得可解释的 ¹H-NMR 光谱。直接分析粗混合物的光谱将加速反应分析，并促进对新化学空间的探索。我们提出了 NIMIS，这是一个结构无关的、基于注意力的深度学习框架，它根据峰值所来源的组分，对一维 ¹H-NMR 混合物光谱中的峰进行分组。J-耦合信息被直接引入多头 Transformer 编码器的注意力机制中，由此得到的上下文化峰值嵌入再通过槽注意力被分离为各个组分。NIMIS 在基于 NMRexp 数据库中实验光谱构建的 158,005 个合成混合物上进行了训练，涵盖由 C、H、N、O、S、F、Cl、Br 和 I 组成的最多含 20 个重原子的分子。在留出的分子上，它达到了峰值到组分（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: NIMIS 是一种无需分子结构先验的深度学习框架，它将 J-耦合化学信息融入 Transformer 的多头注意力机制，并借助槽注意力将一维 ¹H-NMR 混合物光谱中的峰按其来源组分进行分组分离。
en_tdlr: NIMIS is a structure-agnostic deep learning framework that injects J-coupling information into a multi-head Transformer attention mechanism and uses slot attention to group peaks in 1D ¹H-NMR mixture spectra by their originating components.
